To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) we present a parameterized framework that can be used to compute precise call chains in Java; (ii) we describe an application of our framework that computes precise call chains in a test coverage tool; and (iii) we present an approach for measuring the precision of class analysis techniques and we evaluate the limits of class analyses for computing precise call chain information.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following: 1) The problem of call chain analysis, and the development of a framework that can be used for both static and dynamic analysis; 2) An empirical evaluation of the framework and the estimation of the limits of class-based analysis technology.
